big_pour.headline: Microsoft offers buyouts as AI changes jobs
big_pour.summary: Microsoft is offering voluntary buyouts to approximately 60,000 employees across the US, UK, and Canada. This move follows signals that AI is fundamentally changing the size of the company's workforce.
big_pour.why: It shows how AI adoption is leading to significant shifts in employment at major tech companies.
